title: REST API USE - Connector Rule example
author: pvanerp
content: I'm working on implementing a REST API in OS. Can anyone explain the steps? I started by downloading POSTMAN for tests.
solution_text: Got it to work using WebClient in VB.NET: Dim wc As New WebClient, set headers for cache-control, ContentType, Accept, Authorization as Basic, then DownloadString to get JSON and parse with JObject.
